autovalley.title: Auto Valley · Farm assistant
autovalley.tools.title: One-shot work / manual-play recording
autovalley.record.start: Start recording and return to the game
autovalley.record.stop_name: Stop and save recording with a name…
autovalley.record.local: Recordings are saved only on this PC.
autovalley.record.contents: Includes positions and inventory; excludes chat and authentication data.
autovalley.record.no_replay: Saving does not replay actions or upload the recording.
autovalley.record.name_hint: Back and Close do not end this session. Use Stop and save to finish.
autovalley.record.error_start: Could not start recording. Check the recording status and current game connection.
autovalley.record.error_name: Enter a name for this recording.
autovalley.record.error_save: Could not save. The unsaved recording is retained; keep this name and try again.
autovalley.once.title: Choose one job to run, then stop
autovalley.once.hint: Only the selected job runs. Its readiness and cooldown conditions still apply.
autovalley.once.wine_hint: Handle all currently eligible registered wine kegs, then stop. Readiness and cooldowns still apply.
autovalley.once.error_start: Could not start this one-shot job. Check the current game state and registered locations.
autovalley.once.recording_first: Save the manual-play recording before starting automated work.
autovalley.surplus.hint: Ship only excess wine after all registered storage for that wine age group is full.
autovalley.magnet.hint: Continue harvesting when inventory fills; collect ground drops during trips to storage.
autovalley.modules.hint: F8 start / pause · Ctrl+F8 settings · Pause emergency stop
autovalley.background.hint: ON: automation continues while you use other apps; direct input inside Minecraft still pauses it.
autovalley.schedule.hint: Game-day schedule; actual ripe / ready state is still checked.
autovalley.schedule.ready_hint: Clear saved dates after manual work or changing facilities.
autovalley.schedule.dates: Current game day: %s · Earliest next work day: %s
autovalley.schedule.cleared: Saved due dates cleared. Block readiness will be checked when you resume.
autovalley.error.schedule: Enter whole game days from 1 to 28 for each cycle.
autovalley.error.registered: This location or double chest is already registered. Edit it on the Locations tab.
autovalley.error.chest_pair: The double chest is partly unloaded or its pairing changed. Approach both halves and select the chest again.
autovalley.scan.hint: Scan loaded blocks nearby, then select a candidate.
autovalley.scan.done: %s candidates found. Select and confirm each location.
autovalley.machines.bulk_hint: Same machine type, connected within 3 blocks. Confirm this whole area.
autovalley.machines.bulk_partial: This group may extend beyond scanned / loaded blocks. Confirm only these bounds, or move closer and rescan.
autovalley.machines.bulk_paused: Locations are saved together. Automation stays paused.
autovalley.machines.bulk_empty: All machines in this group are already registered.
autovalley.machines.bulk_saved: %s machine locations saved together. Automation remains paused.
autovalley.error.poi_limit: This would exceed 4,096 registered locations. Remove unused locations first.
autovalley.label: Location name
autovalley.classifier: Tomato grade, wine AGE, or +N future reservation
autovalley.classifier.grade: Tomato grade: 0 normal · 1 iron · 2 gold · 3 diamond
autovalley.classifier.year: Wine AGE: 0 = new now · +1 = reserve next year
autovalley.classifier.wine_hint: Plain 0, 1, 2 mean the AGE shown on wine today. +1 reserves next year's newly made wine; +2 reserves the following year's. Each barrel keeps its production cohort as the native wine year advances. Future offsets: +1 to +1000.
autovalley.container.hint: Open this container yourself first and confirm its contents and classification.
autovalley.farms.empty: Add a field using two corners, or confirm a scanned field group.
autovalley.farms.hint: Include both vine heights. Each field: at most 32,768 blocks.
autovalley.farms.reopen_hint: Close, aim at a vine, reopen Ctrl+F8, then capture the next corner.
autovalley.farms.replace_hint: Select a registered field to edit its bounds or name.
autovalley.farms.corners_hint: Aim at tomato vines at opposite corners and heights.
autovalley.farms.corner_captured: Corner captured. Close settings to aim at the other corner.
autovalley.farms.clear_draft: Clear draft and begin a new field
autovalley.farms.suggestions_hint: Suggestions only. Check bounds; nearby fields can merge.
autovalley.farms.scan_done: Found %s field groups from %s tomato blocks. Select a group to confirm its bounds.
autovalley.farms.boundary_hint: Partial bounds: vines reach the scan edge or nearby chunks are unloaded. Move nearer the field center and scan again, or set corners yourself.
autovalley.farms.no_suggestions: No tomato vines found in the loaded scan area.
autovalley.disposal.capture: Face discard target; save position + direction
autovalley.disposal.facing_saved: Discard direction updated. The standing position is unchanged.
autovalley.disposal.edit_hint: Stand at this point and face the discard target. Click to save the new direction.
autovalley.error.disposal_facing: Return to this discard point, face the discard target, then select its saved row to update the direction.
autovalley.waypoint.hint: Record points every 5 blocks, including stairs and turns.
autovalley.saved.empty: No locations registered. Use the Register tab to begin.
autovalley.saved.feet_hint: To move a standing point, remove it and register your new position.
autovalley.error.save: Could not save the local profile. Changes were rolled back; check local file permissions.
autovalley.error.target: Aim at a tomato vine, supported machine, container, or bed before opening settings.
autovalley.error.classifier: Enter tomato grade 0–3, the wine's current AGE (0 or above), or +1 to +1000 for future newly made wine.
autovalley.error.wine_reserve: Reserve future wine with +1 to +1000. The resulting native production year must fit an integer.
autovalley.error.wine_clock: The wine age cannot be determined from the native wine clock. Reopen this location after its clock is available.
autovalley.error.wine_age: That age would precede the start of the wine clock. Check the AGE displayed on the wine.
autovalley.error.wine_clock_changed: The native wine year changed while this form was open. Select the location again and check its AGE or +N reservation.
autovalley.error.container_unchecked: Open and inspect the container yourself, then confirm that its contents match.
autovalley.error.changed: The selected block changed or is no longer loaded. Approach it and scan again.
autovalley.error.tomato_target: Close settings and aim directly at a tomato vine, then reopen settings.
autovalley.error.farm_bounds: Capture two corners. The inclusive box must contain at most 32,768 blocks.
autovalley.error.label: Enter a field name.
autovalley.error.label_used: Another field has this name. Choose a different name or select that field to edit it.
autovalley.error.farm_overlap: These bounds overlap another registered field. Adjust the corners.
autovalley.error.unloaded: This location is outside loaded chunks. Move closer before editing.
autovalley.error.ground: Stand still on a safe solid surface before registering a standing point.
autovalley.error.duplicate: A location is already registered at your feet. Remove it first to change its purpose.
autovalley.error.scan: The nearby scan failed. Check that the world is loaded and try again.
autovalley.error.hoe: Hold a usable hoe in your hotbar, then select Use held hoe.
